## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue when relevant.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. For UI changes, include a redacted screenshot and the viewport sizes checked. For filesystem changes, describe the isolated home and conflict/restore cases checked.

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no personal skill content or credentials.
- [ ] Formatting, tests, and build pass locally, or failures are explained above.
- [ ] User-visible behavior changes are documented in the changelog.
